India’s electronics manufacturing ecosystem is expanding across automotive, consumer electronics, telecommunications, medical devices and industrial applications, increasing demand for reliable PCB manufacturing and assembly capabilities. In India, where the electronics sector reached $115 billion in FY24, PCBs are at the core of an impressive array of devices, including the 1.15 billion mobile phones in use nationwide, as well as electric vehicles and 5G infrastructure. As we look ahead to 2026, India’s pcb manufacturing company leaders are poised to play a pivotal role, driving innovation and strengthening the nation’s position in the global electronics landscape.
